original_test_intent: Validate Type 20 Extended Starting Address as the authoritative 64-bit start of an identified memory-device range only when the legacy start sentinel and structure length require it, with correct Type 17/19 ownership and reboot persistence.
original_method: Collect complete raw Type 17/19/20 and OS-map evidence, gate the extended start by legacy sentinel/length, pair it with extended end, resolve device and parent range, validate 64-bit containment/interleave topology, and repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user provides per-device extended-range expectations and approves reboot; no physical or mapping change is intrinsic.
required_inputs: SMBIOS version/Type 20 length and legacy sentinel rule
Resolved Type 17 device and Type 19 parent ownership
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/OS-map queries; never change memory configuration, firmware or kernel.
Use the extended start only when sentinel and structure length authorize it.
Preserve raw 64-bit value, pair with the same record's extended end and never truncate.
Require reboot approval/recovery; stop on unresolved handle, invalid containment or boot failure and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Gate authority, parse 64-bit per-device range, resolve both handles, validate containment/interleaving and compare pre/post reboot.
Report inactive, absent, truncated, reversed, out-of-parent or drifting ranges without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve extended-address applicability, expected device/array ranges and reboot plan.
Interpret legitimate interleaved/logical mapping differences and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep cannot prove field authority, device/array identity, paired endpoint or containment.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full Type 17/19/20 and OS map; report sentinel/length, raw extended endpoints, resolved handles, normalized range, containment/interleave and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Extended Starting Address scope, script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no memory mapping change is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Gate extended start by legacy sentinel/length, pair with extended end, resolve device and parent range, validate 64-bit topology/containment and compare after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 20 implementations containing extended address fields.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, firmware, parser/dmidecode and OS-map versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 20 legacy sentinel, extended endpoint and handle definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds conditional authority, raw 64-bit pairing and end-to-end ownership/containment.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects inactive, truncated, wrong-device and out-of-array starts missed by grep.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved extended ranges, sentinel and topology policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An extended value is not authoritative outside its sentinel condition; OS aggregate maps do not replace per-device identity.

project_override_considerations: A project may use legacy or extended per-device ranges based on topology, but must apply the sentinel/length rule and preserve explicit Type 17/19 ownership.
expected_evidence: Approved extended-address/sentinel/topology policy and expected per-device map
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 17/19/20 records with versions/lengths
Per-record sentinel, raw extended endpoints, device/array handles and containment result
Read-only OS/e820 correlation and interleave disposition
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Extended Starting Address is a valid conditional Type 20 field; expected per-device map is a project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Authority gating, 64-bit parsing, relationship and containment checks are fully automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds sentinel/length authority, paired range and Type 17/19 ownership checks.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains conditional-field safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates missing platform data/reboot approval and engineer verdict from automation.

review_improvement: Prevents a displayed extended start from passing when inactive, unpaired, truncated or assigned outside the correct device/array topology.
independent_technical_reasoning: Conditional field selection and 64-bit topology validation are deterministic read-only software work once project expectations are supplied.
